meta.name: gget
meta.description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis, OpenTargets, COSMIC, CELLxGENE, and 8cube mouse specificity/expression data. Best for interactive exploration and simple queries. For batch processing or advanced BLAST use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.

copy.tagline: 快速查询20多个生物信息学数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速从20多个生物信息学数据库获取基因、序列或结构信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need fast lookups across 20+ bioinformatics databases for genes, sequences, or structures

howto.what: 装上gget后，Claude可以运行gget命令或Python函数，从20多个生物信息学数据库快速查询基因信息、序列比对（BLAST/BLAT）、蛋白质结构（PDB/AlphaFold）、表达数据（ARCHS4/CELLxGENE）、富集分析（Enrichr）等。
howto.when: 当用户要求查询基因信息、做序列比对、下载参考基因组、预测蛋白质结构或进行富集分析时触发。

say.text: 用gget查询人类PAX7基因的详细信息。
帮我用gget做一次BLAT比对，序列是ATCGATCG。
用gget的enrichr对这几个基因做通路富集分析。

howto.what_en: With gget installed, Claude can run gget commands or Python functions to quickly query over 20 bioinformatics databases for gene info, sequence alignment (BLAST/BLAT), protein structures (PDB/AlphaFold), expression data (ARCHS4/CELLxGENE), and enrichment analysis (Enrichr).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to look up gene information, perform sequence alignment, download reference genomes, predict protein structures, or run enrichment analysis.

say_en.text: Use gget to query detailed info for human PAX7 gene.
Run a BLAT alignment with gget for sequence ATCGATCG.
Use gget enrichr to perform pathway enrichment on these genes.
